desc:
• Easy homemade sugar cookies with minimal prep work

  • Perfect for holidays, parties, and special occasions

  • Trusted Betty Crocker quality for consistent, delicious results

  • Ready-to-use mix saves time in the kitchen

  • Includes quality ingredients for traditional taste
features:
Features

Classic sugar cookie mix: Creates soft, chewy sugar cookies easily—just add butter and an egg.

Convenient pouch size: Includes one 17.5 oz pouch—enough for around 22–24 regular cookies.

Simple prep instructions: Follow the package for drop cookies or roll and cut for cut‑out shapes—recipes available on the Betty Crocker website.

Trusted recipe: From America’s #1 cookie mix brand—backed by over a century of baking experience.
ingredients: Sugar, Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Palm Oil, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate), Salt, Nonfat Milk.
